ISSUE-001 exactly identifies the false reverse implication in the theorem's biconditional: stationarity of the new point does not imply equality of consecutive objective values. It supplies the same scalar counterexample and the same one-way repair, while preserving the valid forward implication and descent result.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The theorem incorrectly asserts equivalence between objective equality and stationarity; only equality implying stationarity is valid, while stationarity need not imply equality after the current surrogate step.
